plans.text: Frame the "Moonlit Ocean" digital print and hang it in the bedroom.
Consider temporarily moving the "Moonlit Ocean" print to the party area for display.
Display some of their own art pieces around the party area to create a cozy atmosphere.
Set up a little corner with art books and magazines, including those from The Artisan Post and Creative Corner, to provide inspiration for guests.
Set up a little station where guests can create their own art journals.
Set up a little station where guests can take photos with fun props and art-themed backdrops.

Create a dreamlike scene with a figure floating in a misty, ethereal environment, using soft pastel colors to evoke calmness and serenity and experimenting with layering and blending techniques to create depth and atmosphere.
Experiment with glazing, soft brushstrokes, and layered transparent washes to create mistiness and build up atmosphere.

superseded_plans.text: Create a piece combining their love of abstract art with their fascination with the human figure.
Create a piece incorporating a figure in a dreamlike environment, using atmosphere and mood to convey a sense of wonder.
